text: Binary flag from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; parsed): 1 if at least one comment introduces a concrete external factual analogy, meaning a specific actual real-world case, event, situation or comparison from outside the OP's own scenario, used as an analogy or parallel to the topic. A concrete personal experience may qualify, and the commenter need not endorse the analogy. Purely invented hypotheticals, abstract principles and pure logical reasoning without a concrete real-world case don't count. Returns 0 if the list is valid and either nonempty with no qualifying comment, or empty. Returns null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. List order is irrelevant. OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thanks or resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred are ignored as evidence; generic discussion of delta or platform rules is allowed if relevant. Judged from the supplied current text only.
